about: What is open for Jafar, one item a thing he is asked (his order of 2 November 2026: one permanent page, 'LEDGER: Needs you'). state: open or done; an item leaves the page when he has answered it or done it, and stays here with 'closed' (when, and how). Read by tools/needs_you_page.py; published beside the page and copied into its database (collection 'items') for the advisor's checker.

items.text: While signed in to Fab, press Download on each of Epic's four free MetaHuman footwear files and save them in F:\LedgerTools\fab (about 1.2 GB in all).
items.recommendation: Download all four: Epic's boots for Tom's toe shape (your yes of 31 October), the others for the cast. I look at each before using it.

items.text: May I make one more try at the pale line where anything meets the wet street? Three tries on Tom's boots failed; it comes from the wet ground's water layer at every contact, so this try would be in the ground's material.
items.recommendation: Yes: the line shows under every foot and object on the wet street, and the corner's wet ground needs it gone.

items.text: In the Claude app's sidebar, open the session "LEDGER: read back page answers (nightly)" (stuck since 26 October) and press Stop, so the nightly read-back of your answers can run again.
items.recommendation: Stop it: it has blocked every nightly run since 27 October; I read your answers by hand meanwhile. There is no web link for a session; it is in the app's sidebar.
